content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Conventional platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle offer hosted solutions where you rent access to their infrastructure. They handle payment processing, order management, and product delivery—but only if your country is allowed. These platforms are closed systems: you cannot modify their backend logic, access raw transaction data, or bypass their payment processors. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you ownership of the entire stack. Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages hosts your store for free. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets stores orders. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain with a 0.5% fee. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. No platform can revoke access. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture in 48 hours, configured for plugins, with SPF/DKIM/DMARC email security and end-to-end testing. The tradeoff is clear: rented convenience versus owned infrastructure.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms exclude countries like Nigeria based on financial policies, currency controls, or perceived risk. These restrictions are not temporary—they are structural. Even if a platform re-enters your market, they can leave again. Sovereign commerce infrastructure avoids this entirely by using open, decentralized components. Cloudflare and Supabase do not restrict countries. NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies without KYC, regardless of location. The architecture is permissionless: no entity can block access. For plugins, this means your customers in Nigeria, Ghana, or Kenya can pay using BSC, Solana, or TRON—networks with transaction fees under $0.10. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this architecture with your plugins pre-loaded, so you’re operational in 48 hours. Conventional platforms lock you out. Sovereign infrastructure locks you in—to ownership.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal process payments instantly but charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, plus additional fees for currency conversion or chargebacks. They also hold funds for days or weeks. Crypto payments via NOWPayments confirm on-chain within minutes, with a flat 0.5% fee and no buyer account required. For plugins priced at $50, Stripe takes $1.75 per sale; NOWPayments takes $0.25. The real cost difference is infrastructure dependency. Stripe’s fees are high because they rent you access to their closed system. Sovereign infrastructure has no recurring fees: Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase are free tiers. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this for $197, with no subscriptions. You pay once, own everything, and keep 99.5% of every sale. For plugin creators in restricted markets, this is not just cost-effective—it’s the only structural solution.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you ownership, not rented access.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Conventional platforms own your customer data, transaction history, and delivery process. They can suspend your account or change their terms at any time. Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full ownership. Your store lives on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery happens via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments triggers delivery automatically via webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The Edge Commerce Stack includes this automation, pre-configured for plugins. Your customers receive their download links instantly, without you lifting a finger. No platform dependency. No risk of account suspension. Full data ownership. For plugin creators, this means your business cannot be shut down by a third party’s policy change. You own the architecture—and the rules.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If your country is supported by Stripe or PayPal and you sell low-margin products, conventional platforms might suffice—for now. But if you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, or another restricted market, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only permanent solution. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture in 48 hours, with your plugins pre-loaded and email security configured. It’s built for creators who need ownership, not workarounds. If you’re selling high-value plugins or software, the savings from 0.5% fees versus 2.9%+ quickly offset the deployment cost. If you’re in a market where financial isolation is a reality, not a possibility, this is base-layer infrastructure—not a temporary fix. Choose rented convenience if you can. Choose owned architecture if you must.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Crypto payments via NOWPayments cost 0.5%—compared to Stripe’s 2.9%+

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages (free). 2. Set up backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script (free). 3. Configure order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets (free). 4. Integrate payment processing: NOWPayments for crypto (0.5% fee). 5. Set up file delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 (free). 6. Deploy your plugins and test end-to-end. 7. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email security. 8. Automate delivery via NOWPayments webhooks. 9. Launch your store with full ownership and no platform dependency.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this infrastructure if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys the entire architecture for you, pre-configured for plugins, with 30-day support included.
What cryptocurrencies can my customers use?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended low-fee networks include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transaction fees under $0.10.
Do I need to host my plugins on a specific platform?
No. You can host plugin files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, both of which integrate seamlessly with the Edge Commerce Stack.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments is a verification layer, not a custodian. Payments are on-chain, and delivery is triggered via webhook. If NOWPayments fails, you can manually verify transactions using blockchain explorers.
Can I scale this infrastructure as my business grows?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack includes a scaling playbook, and the architecture is designed to handle increased traffic and transactions without additional platform fees.
